Northrock Partners Holding in Ameriprise Finl (AMP) Decreased by $4.34 Million as Stock Price Declined; Enbridge (ENB) Shareholder Donaldson Capital Management Lowered Holding by $517,413
May 25, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Northrock Partners Llc decreased its stake in Ameriprise Finl Inc (AMP) by 32.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northrock Partners Llc sold 25,674 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.11% with the market. The institutional investor held 54,145 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.18M, down from 79,819 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northrock Partners Llc who had been investing in Ameriprise Finl Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $20.58 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.22% or $0.31 during the last trading session, reaching $142.31. About 577,257 shares traded. Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE:AMP) has risen 17.58% since May 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.03% the S&P500.
Donaldson Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Enbridge Incorporated (ENB) by 2.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 524,604 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $20.52M, down from 537,871 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Donaldson Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Enbridge Incorporated for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $53.23 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.82% or $0.26 during the last trading session, reaching $31.32. About 1.60M shares traded. Enbridge Inc. (NYSE:ENB) has declined 26.13% since May 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 37.68% the S&P500.
